budget.fit_reuse_rule: If final is unconditioned ensemble, three fits include seed11 reference; conditioned ensemble needs three candidate fits plus one seed11 reference; conditioned single-seed needs two fits. No separate fit is spent for a reference already present.
budget.notes: Caps are proposed resource limits, not measured forecasts. Start with a label-free resource pilot. Train and save once, release training tensors, then infer in causal five-day chunks to avoid materializing all later months. Timeout/OOM stops and records failure; no silent budget extension or quality-based retries.

calibration.formula: sqrt(mean over periods of sample variance across seeds)), baseline=1500 steps
calibration.limitations: Only two four-day July windows. Uncertain noise scale, not an official scoring tradeoff. Thresholds apply prospectively to this proposal and must be frozen before new candidate outcomes.

data_roles.legacy_final: 2023-08-03 through 2023-08-04 remains reserved and is not accessed by this protocol. One day is insufficient evidence for deployment.
data_roles.official_training_data: Available 2020-2024 data. Internally partition by time into fitting, research, confirmation and locked-test roles.
data_roles.old_july_eight_days: Exploratory only, already repeatedly used for selection; no longer independent confirmation.
data_roles.private_leaderboard: External final test; no tuning or fitting on its labels.
data_roles.public_leaderboard: External feedback and platform compatibility check after internal recipe freeze; never daily hyperparameter search.

deployment.confirmation: Refit the frozen recipe once on the listed June dates, then use exactly those weights for all twenty July dates.
deployment.locked_test: After confirmation passes without recipe changes, refit that same recipe once on listed September dates; freeze those weights for all 61 Q4 trading days. Score the entire test only after prediction artifacts and hashes are fixed.
deployment.research: Each research origin fits its preceding ten trading days once, then freezes those weights for the full following ten-day window. This measures transfer of the training recipe across origins.
deployment.rolling_updates: Out of scope unless platform rules explicitly permit labels becoming available and online retraining. Such a policy needs its own matched chronological simulation.

experiment_1.hypothesis: Averaging seed-specific errors improves subsequent-date ordering and stability at acceptable inference cost.
experiment_1.only_factor: fixed seed11 prediction -> (seed11+seed29+seed47)/3 in original label units
experiment_1.rationale: Require gain larger than one measured same-window baseline seed standard deviation to justify executing three models, in addition to a positive paired interval. This is a proposed decision policy before any new results, not a retroactive claim about the July experiment.
experiment_1.reuse: Seed11 is the reference and is trained only once per origin. All per-seed predictions are retained.

experiment_2.comparison: Hold the deployment aggregation chosen in experiment 1 fixed. Compare old vs conditioned model with the same seeds and aggregation; never attribute ensemble gains to the opening branch.
experiment_2.condition_source: Prediction key timestamp in Shanghai exchange time; never last observed bar time.
experiment_2.formula: score = w^T h + b + I[prediction time == 09:30] * v^T h
experiment_2.hypothesis: The opening needs a feature-dependent readout reflecting its distinct trading stage.
experiment_2.initialization: v=zeros, constructed after all baseline parameters without consuming random draws; shared baseline parameters and sample order exactly paired by seed.
experiment_2.screen: Run seed11 for both research origins first; if a preregistered guardrail clearly fails, stop. Otherwise complete seeds29/47 before selecting. No additional seed search.

leakage_controls: Purge by the actual label-window end: training label end strictly before evaluation start; handle the 30 trading-minute lunch boundary explicitly.
Split full prediction timestamps/dates, not random stock rows.
Fit target scaling and every learned preprocessing parameter on fitting data only.
Historical lookback may overlap prior fitting dates: permitted causal information, not leakage by itself.
Never fit on public/private evaluation labels; no future stock membership, backward filling, or future-fitted preprocessing.
Pin data snapshots and cache identities to source hash, columns, role and time bounds; changing config names cannot reopen locked data.
Predictions and model hashes fixed before confirmation/locked scoring; same frozen weights across all evaluation chunks.
minimal_behavior_checks: Zero-initialized opening branch equals baseline predictions and preserves existing parameter initialization/sample order.

A constructed feature example proves the opening branch can alter cross-sectional ordering; non-opening branch contribution is zero. Shared-trunk training may still change non-opening predictions and is measured by guardrails.
Existing causal-window and no-label-inference tests remain passing.
Checkpoint PT/JSON load and local/platform condition construction agree, with explicit error for missing context.
protocol.objective: Test fixed-seed averaging and one opening-conditioned readout inside official development data, then assess a frozen candidate across later dates without using public/private leaderboard feedback to tune it.

public_sources.boundary: Do not apply a row-based gap directly to mixed stock rows; purge actual label-end timestamps.
public_sources.title: TimeSeriesSplit and gap

public_sources.boundary: Motivates feature-dependent conditioning; does not prove this opening readout improves financial metrics.
public_sources.title: FiLM conditional feature modulation

selection.confirmation: One frozen candidate vs the original unconditioned seed11 reference, same label/key hashes and no candidate search. For all three candidate outcomes the primary is all-day RankIC: mean difference > 0 and 95% paired five-day-block lower bound > 0. Research noise-unit minimum-gain thresholds are NOT reused as an all-day opening-only confirmation threshold. Apply the explicit mean/interval/worst-day/cost guardrails; retain component-attribution claims only for research evidence.
selection.cost_gate: Measure inference on the exact same input keys; actual full platform pipeline <= 3 hours and within its documented memory limit. Three-model execution cost cannot be inferred from model count alone. Local 6144MiB run cap is not the platform memory limit.
selection.failure_policy: Do not expand searches or change gates after outcomes. Fix a verified implementation bug with a new run ID; record that viewed evaluation data are consumed. Changed research direction requires untouched later evidence.
selection.final_reference: Original unconditioned seed11 model, refit once using the same prescribed fitting dates and unchanged recipe. This reference identity is fixed for ensemble-only, opening-only and combined outcomes.

fixed_group_failure_flag.groups: Only the eight fixed prediction times and the four fixed weight-age groups, with >=5 complete days. Optional volatility/liquidity breakdowns remain descriptive.
fixed_group_failure_flag.interpretation: The same old all-day tolerance is deliberately applied to each group as a conservative practical decision rule; it is not a group-specific noise estimate, a multiplicity-adjusted significance test, or a guarantee of private stability. No thresholds are chosen after results.
fixed_group_failure_flag.rule: If any prespecified group mean RankIC difference < -calibration.seed_noise.rank_ic_mean, or gross long-short difference < -calibration.seed_noise.long_short_return_mean, downgrade overall accept to inconclusive.

selection.guardrails: Gross long-short mean must not decline; turnover mean must not increase; for opening experiment full-day RankIC mean must not decline. For these means, paired interval lower bounds (or upper for turnover) must also exclude deterioration greater than one archived seed-noise unit. Observed worst-day deterioration must not exceed the archived worst-day seed noise. A failure retains the reference; ambiguous intervals mean inconclusive, not success.
selection.locked: Exactly one final comparison with that same reference and confirmation gates after all decisions are frozen. Predeclared age/time/stress groups are reported, not searched. Their noise was not separately calibrated: group intervals are descriptive; they cannot independently establish success. The explicitly defined common-tolerance diagnostic below can downgrade a putative overall acceptance to inconclusive. Failure does not permit tuning on this test.
selection.primary_gate: Mean paired gain >= the relevant preregistered minimum AND the 95% continuous-day-block interval lower bound > 0; each research window mean gain > 0.
selection.shared_research_only: Both experiments may use the two research windows. Their data are openly treated as selection data.
selection.single_confirmation_opening: Complete both research decisions and freeze one final recipe before opening the common confirmation labels/metrics. Do not use experiment1 confirmation results to redesign experiment2.

statistics.sensitivity_rule: Report both; do not choose whichever makes the candidate pass. Conflicting conclusions are inconclusive.
statistics.stress_groups: Fixed eight prediction times and weight-age groups. Additional high/low volatility or liquidity thresholds fitted from the fitting period only, and applied using only as-of data. No result-driven subgroup selection.
statistics.unit: trading day; average prediction timestamps within day, never count stocks or seeds as independent market days

window_status.scope_limit: Scanning current configs does not prove absence of all historical/manual exposure. Before activation reconcile historical run/data provenance, check only schema/coverage and enforce the roles in a shared access registry. Never silently substitute windows after seeing performance.
window_status.selection_basis: Calendar dates from stock-pool date column only; no new label or candidate metric values.
